{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check which patient_ids are duplicated
duplicate_patients = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]['patient_id'].unique()
print(f"Duplicate patient_ids: {duplicate_patients}")

# Check sample_seq for duplicated patients
df_dup = df[df['patient_id'].isin(duplicate_patients)]
df_dup_sorted = df_dup.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
print(f"For duplicated patients, highest sample_seq per patient:\n{df_dup_sorted[['patient_id', 'sample_seq']].head(10)}")"}
